serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: These are our seats.
Bot: When does the movie start?
You: First we need to wait for the start of the showing, after that 20 minutes of ads.
Bot: Why are there ads? Aren’t we paying for the tickets?
You: That’s how cinemas work. They show trailers for upcoming movies. {{wi}}And sometimes for a new flavor of popcorn.
You: Hey, maybe some trailer will catch your interest and we won’t have the same problem with choosing a movie like this time.
Bot: Alright, that makes sense.
